Given our proven track record of successfully integrating acquisitions and realizing operational synergies, we are confident that Purvi Gems will further strengthen our growth platform and support sustainable long-term value creation."
Jigar Mehta, Director, Purvi Gems and Jewellery (India) Pvt Ltd added, "Over the last fifteen years, we have built a strong reputation in lightweight, uncut, and Precia jewellery through our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, and customer relationships. We believe Sky Gold’s scale, manufacturing capabilities, extensive customer network, and proven track record of integrating and growing acquired businesses provide the ideal platform for the next phase of our growth."
The acquisition reinforces Sky Gold’s focus on expanding its jewellery manufacturing business through strategic acquisitions while strengthening its presence in the studded jewellery, lightweight jewellery, and export-oriented jewellery segments.
India’s premium whisky market is evolving beyond the bottle. As consumer interest shifts toward authenticity, provenance, and immersive experiences, distilleries are increasingly becoming an extension of the brand itself. Gamber Valley, the Indian single malt whisky brand from Alcobrew Distilleries, is embracing this trend by positioning its Solan facility not only as a production centre but also as a destination that showcases the journey of whisky making.
Launched in 2026, Gamber Valley represents Alcobrew’s entry into the premium Indian single malt category. Distilled, matured, and bottled at the company’s facility in Solan, Himachal Pradesh, the brand draws heavily on its Himalayan location to shape its identity. The surrounding climate, altitude, and access to water from the region form an integral part of the whisky’s production environment and brand narrative.
Unlike many whisky brands that focus primarily on the finished product, Gamber Valley is placing equal emphasis on the process behind the spirit. The brand’s positioning is built around the idea that whisky is shaped not only by ingredients and production techniques but also by the environment in which it matures. This philosophy is reflected in its identity, which highlights altitude, climate, water, oak, and time as defining elements of the whisky-making journey.
A visit to the Solan distillery offers a detailed look into the stages that shape the final spirit. From fermentation and distillation to cask selection and maturation, the facility allows visitors to see firsthand how whisky develops long before it reaches consumers.
For premium spirits brands, creating visibility around production is becoming increasingly important. Consumers are no longer interested only in tasting notes and packaging. They want to understand the craftsmanship, infrastructure, and expertise behind the product. By opening up its production story, Gamber Valley is creating a more tangible connection between the whisky and the consumer.
One of the key highlights of the distillery experience is the role of oak casks in shaping flavour. Factors such as barrel type, previous cask usage, charring levels, and ageing conditions all contribute to the character of the whisky over time.
This approach is reflected in Gamber Valley’s current portfolio, which includes Private Collection 1 and The Vault Series. Both expressions showcase different maturation approaches and provide insight into how cask management influences flavour development. The maturation facilities house thousands of barrels, including ex-bourbon and virgin oak casks, highlighting the scale of the ageing programme behind the brand.
Water is another important component of Gamber Valley’s identity. The Solan facility features a 6 lakh litre water tank and sources water from the surrounding Gamber Valley region. Alcobrew has consistently linked the region’s natural resources and environmental conditions with the production process and the whisky’s final character.
For a growing Indian single malt brand, this emphasis on place helps create a stronger sense of origin. Rather than positioning itself as simply another whisky produced in India, Gamber Valley is using its Himalayan location to establish a distinct identity within the premium spirits market.
The company’s ambitions extend beyond whisky production. Alcobrew has outlined plans for a visitor centre and a new maturation hall at the Solan facility. According to company documents, the visitor centre will feature guided distillery tours, tasting lounges, and a heritage gallery dedicated to spirits, giving visitors a deeper understanding of the whisky-making process.
The move reflects a growing trend in the global spirits industry, where distilleries are being developed as hospitality and tourism destinations. Instead of limiting consumer interaction to retail shelves or tasting events, brands are creating environments where visitors can engage directly with production, ageing, and brand heritage.
Gamber Valley is also preparing to broaden its product portfolio. Trademark filings submitted in June 2026 indicate plans for new expressions, including Gamber Valley Pravah and Gamber Valley Tapah. As the range expands, the brand will have greater opportunities to offer comparative tastings and deepen consumer understanding of different maturation styles and flavour profiles.
The premium spirits industry is increasingly recognizing that consumers want more than a product. They want access to the story behind it. Distillery visits provide that context by allowing consumers to see the production process, understand maturation techniques, explore cask programmes, and experience the environment where the whisky is created.
For Gamber Valley, the Solan distillery serves as more than a manufacturing facility. It acts as a platform for storytelling, consumer engagement, and brand building. As competition intensifies in India’s single malt whisky segment, experiences such as distillery tours, tastings, and whisky hospitality may become just as important as the spirit itself in shaping consumer perception.
Electric vehicle manufacturer River Mobility has partnered with Flipkart to make its electric scooter, the Indie, available through the e-commerce platform, strengthening its omnichannel retail strategy in India. The collaboration, which begins with Flipkart’s Big Billion Days sale, will combine River Mobility’s existing offline retail network with Flipkart’s digital marketplace.
Customers will be able to discover, explore, and book the Indie electric scooter online while continuing to access sales and service support through the company's physical retail outlets. As part of the partnership, the Indie will be available through the River brand store on Flipkart, where customers can access product specifications, pricing information, and brand-related content. River Mobility said the scooter is currently accessible across more than 80 cities and that availability on Flipkart will automatically expand as the company enters new markets and opens additional retail locations.
Aravind Mani, Co-Founder and CEO, River Mobility said, “Partnering with Flipkart is a natural next step, bringing the Indie closer to online customers and expanding our reach, backed by our robust service network. Having steadily built our retail foundation, we are confident in our ability to deliver a great ownership experience.”
The River Indie electric scooter is positioned in the electric two-wheeler segment and features a 4 kWh battery pack with a claimed IDC range of 163 km. The scooter offers a top speed of 90 km/h and comes with 55 litres of storage capacity. The latest version of the scooter includes features such as hill-hold control, a redesigned lighter chassis, 177 mm ground clearance, and an updated 6-inch display with enhanced smartphone connectivity. The integration allows users to access ride statistics and real-time charging information through the companion mobile application.
The partnership reflects the growing role of e-commerce in India's electric vehicle market, where manufacturers are increasingly adopting omnichannel retail models to improve accessibility and customer reach. By combining online booking with offline sales and service infrastructure, River Mobility aims to strengthen consumer access to electric mobility solutions across India. The company currently operates in 48 cities through a network of 72 stores and continues to expand its retail footprint across key EV markets.
Baazar Style Retail Limited (BSRL), which operates the Style Baazar value fashion retail chain, reported revenue growth during the first half of FY27 while continuing to expand its store network across key markets in Eastern India. For H1 FY27, the company’s revenue from operations increased 6 percent year-on-year to Rs 9,645 million. The retailer attributed its performance to continued business growth despite a shift in the festive calendar, with Durga Puja falling in Q3 FY27 compared to Q2 FY26.
The company expanded its retail footprint to 283 stores as of September 30, 2026, representing 13 percent year-on-year growth. Total rental area increased 16 percent year-on-year to 26.69 lakh sq ft, reflecting the retailer’s ongoing expansion strategy in the value fashion segment. During the second quarter, Style Baazar added 14 new stores and closed seven stores as part of its network optimisation efforts.
Revenue from operations stood at Rs 4,781 million in Q2 FY27, registering a 10 percent year-on-year decline. According to the company, the decrease was largely due to the timing of the festive season, which benefited Q2 FY26 but shifted to Q3 in the current financial year. Reported Same Store Sales Growth (SSSG) stood at negative 25 percent during the quarter, while sales per square foot reached Rs 642 per month, compared to Rs 865 per month in the corresponding period last year.
For the first six months of FY27, Same Store Sales Growth stood at negative 11 percent. Sales per square foot was reported at Rs 660 per month compared to Rs 768 per month in H1 FY26. Despite the impact of the festive shift, the company continued to focus on store expansion, consumer reach, and operational capabilities to strengthen its position in India's value fashion retail market.
During the festive season, Style Baazar launched several brand visibility initiatives aimed at increasing customer engagement. The retailer created what it described as the World's Largest Fashion Wardrobe, a 50 ft × 25 ft installation at City Centre, Salt Lake, Bidhannagar. The installation received a Guinness World Record title and was used to showcase the company's festive fashion collections and strengthen consumer awareness during the festive shopping season.
Style Baazar also expanded its marketing efforts through sports partnerships. The company became the Principal Partner for India's international football matches against Brazil and Uruguay, both former FIFA World Cup champions, scheduled to take place in Kolkata.
The association is expected to help the retailer connect with a wider audience and strengthen brand visibility among consumers across India. With an expanding retail network, growing market presence, and continued investments in consumer engagement, Baazar Style Retail said it remains focused on building a scalable value fashion retail business while improving store productivity and operational efficiency.
Godrej Consumer Products Indonesia (GCPI), the Indonesian subsidiary of Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL), has inaugurated the first phase of its new manufacturing facility in the Kendal Special Economic Zone. The development is part of an IDR 500 billion (approximately Rs 250 crore) investment aimed at expanding the company’s manufacturing capacity and strengthening its presence in Indonesia.
The investment builds on GCPI’s operations in Indonesia, where the company has been active since 2010. Over the years, the business has grown 4.5 times, with brands such as HIT, Stella, Mitu, and NYU reaching nearly one in four Indonesian households. The first phase of the Kendal facility has been developed on 2.5 hectares of the company’s 5.5-hectare site and is dedicated to the production of household insecticide products. The facility is expected to support domestic demand while also serving export markets across the region.
The inauguration ceremony was attended by government officials from India and Indonesia, including the Ambassador of India to Indonesia, the Deputy Governor of Central Java, the Regent of Kendal, and representatives from Indonesia’s Ministry of Investment and Downstream Industry/BKPM.
Sandeep Chakravorty, Ambassador of India to Indonesia said, “India and Indonesia share deep rooted historical and cultural ties, and there is tremendous potential to build an equally strong economic partnership. Godrej, one of India’s most prominent business houses, has been present in Indonesia since 2010. Its products have made significant impact in the Indonesian market due to quality and affordability. Its new manufacturing facility in Kendal is a concrete example of this partnership in action. The facility will serve both Indonesia and export markets, strengthening the connection between investment, manufacturing and trade. We would like to see many more such examples of Indian and Indonesian businesses investing, growing and creating value together.”
For GCPL, the Kendal plant represents a key step in expanding its manufacturing footprint in Southeast Asia and supporting future growth in the home care and personal care categories.
Aasif Malbari, Managing Director and CEO, Godrej Consumer Products Limited said, “Indonesia is an important part of our business, and we believe there is significant headroom to grow. Kendal is a big step in that direction. Our IDR 500 billion investment in the new Indonesian plant will expand home and personal care categories capacity by approximately 15 percent. This expansion addresses current capacity utilization of 75-80 percent, positioning us to meet rising regional demand and scale. GCPI is truly an Indonesian company, and we believe this investment is in the interest of the economic development of this region and this country. Where we see opportunity, we do not shy away from investing. We also believe Kendal will become a platform for exports around the region.”
The company said the facility was built in just over a year and incorporates technology and data-driven systems to improve operational visibility, manufacturing efficiency, and decision-making capabilities.
Rajesh Sethuraman, Business Head, Indonesia and Global Head, Business Transformation and Digital, GCPL said, “What excites me about Kendal is not only what we have built, but how we have built it. In just over a year, we have created a manufacturing platform with technology and data embedded from the start, giving us better visibility and enabling us to operate more effectively and at speed. For a consumer business, that matters. It brings us closer to real demand, helps us make faster decisions and gives us the capability to turn consumer insight into relevant innovation at scale.”
Alongside manufacturing expansion, the company said the facility has been designed with a focus on workforce inclusion, sustainability, and responsible operations.
Vaibhav Ram, Global Head, Human Resources, GCPL added, “For us, how we grow matters as much as how much we grow. At Kendal, inclusion is being designed into the workplace, with an ambition for women to represent 50 percent of the workforce alongside meaningful opportunities for persons with disabilities. The same thinking extends to how we operate, with responsible manufacturing built into the facility from the start, from resource efficiency and energy visibility to biodiversity and waste management. This is about making inclusion and responsibility part of how we do business, every day.”
The new facility is expected to strengthen GCPL’s manufacturing network in Indonesia while supporting exports, local employment generation, and the company’s long-term growth strategy in the region.
Real estate developer BPTP has announced the launch of The Boulevard at Green Oaks, a new high-street retail development in Sector 70A, Gurugram. Located within the Astaire Gardens ecosystem, the project is designed to serve the growing residential population in the area through a mix of retail, food and beverage, wellness, and lifestyle offerings.
The commercial development is positioned adjacent to the 100-acre Astaire Gardens township and is expected to cater to residents of nearby communities, including BPTP Visionnaire, BPTP Fortuna, BPTP Green Oaks, and BPTP Pedestal. Strategically located on a 24-metre-wide road, the project offers connectivity to Sectors 68 to 72, Southern Peripheral Road (SPR), and Golf Course Extension Road, providing access to several established and emerging residential neighbourhoods across Gurugram.
The Boulevard at Green Oaks comprises 52 retail units ranging from 612 sq ft to 1,217 sq ft. The development has been planned as a neighbourhood-focused retail destination, accommodating categories such as cafés, restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacies, beauty and wellness outlets, and other essential services.
The project has been designed around the increasing demand for convenience-led retail experiences within residential catchments. Features include landscaped walkways, open retail zones, pedestrian-friendly spaces, and dedicated areas for dining and community engagement. In terms of infrastructure, the development includes a glass-and-clad façade, high-capacity premium lifts, and surface parking facilities. The project is also IGBC registered, highlighting its focus on sustainability and environmental performance.
Amaan Chawla, President, BPTP said, “The Boulevard at Green Oaks reflects our approach to creating commercial destinations that respond to how urban communities live and engage today. As residential ecosystems mature, the demand for convenient, well-planned retail and lifestyle destinations grows alongside them. With its strategic location within Astaire Gardens, strong surrounding residential base and pedestrian-friendly design, The Boulevard at Green Oaks is envisioned as a destination that integrates everyday convenience with meaningful experiences for residents, businesses and visitors.”
The project is expected to benefit from the ongoing development of Gurugram’s growth corridor, where residential expansion, commercial activity, and infrastructure improvements continue to drive demand for organised retail and mixed-use developments. With the launch of The Boulevard at Green Oaks, BPTP is further expanding its commercial real estate portfolio, focusing on neighbourhood retail formats that combine accessibility, location advantages, and evolving consumer requirements.
Patel Retail Limited has expanded its in-house food brand, Indian Chaska, with the launch of a new whole spices range, strengthening its presence in the packaged spices and FMCG food segment. The company said the launch is aimed at catering to everyday household consumption as well as growing demand in domestic and international markets. The new portfolio includes a wide range of whole spices commonly used in Indian cooking, covering categories such as seasoning, flavouring, and traditional spice blends.
The Indian Chaska Whole Spices range includes 23 products across multiple categories. Everyday cooking essentials include cumin seed (jeera), coriander seed (dhania), fennel seed (saunf), mustard seed (rai), yellow mustard, fenugreek seed (methi dana), carom seeds (ajwain), dry red chilli, and black pepper. The portfolio also features aromatic spices such as green cardamom, black cardamom, clove, cinnamon, bay leaf, star anise, mace, whole nutmeg, and dry ginger. Specialty products include nigella seeds, poppy seed, black sesame, gond (dried gum), and khada garam masala.
To cater to different consumption needs, the products will be available in pack sizes ranging from 10g and 20g to 500g and 1kg for select items. The company said the packaging options are designed for both trial purchases and regular household usage.
The spices are manufactured at Patel Retail’s processing facility in Kutch, Gujarat. According to the company, the products are sourced, cleaned, graded, and packed through its existing processing and sourcing network. In addition to whole spices, Indian Chaska also offers a portfolio of blended spices.
Dhanji Patel, Chairman and Managing Director of Patel Retail Limited said, "Our brand-building strategy is centered on bringing authentic, quality Indian spices closer to customers across households and growing domestic and global markets while strengthening our presence in key product categories. The launch of our Whole Spices under Indian Chaska reflects this approach and further expands our product portfolio. Every new product range enables us to better serve the everyday needs of our customers by providing convenient access to quality whole spices, carefully sourced, cleaned, graded and packed to preserve natural aroma, colour and flavour, through our in-house brand. As we continue to grow the Indian Chaska brand, our focus remains on enhancing product quality, strengthening long-term relationships with our customers and creating sustainable value for all our stakeholders. We will continue to expand our offerings in line with our long-term growth ambitions while delivering a consistent and trusted experience."
The launch comes as India's packaged spices market continues to witness steady growth, driven by rising demand for branded food products, convenience-led cooking solutions, and increased adoption of packaged grocery products across urban and non-urban markets.
Alternicq Limited, one of India's largest rigid plastic packaging manufacturers, has expanded its packaging solutions portfolio through an exclusive partnership with UK-based packaging technology company Pulpex. The collaboration will introduce Pulpex’s pulp fibre bottle technology to India, strengthening Alternicq’s presence in sustainable packaging and FMCG packaging solutions.
The move marks another step in the company's strategy to evolve from a packaging manufacturer into an integrated packaging solutions provider offering services across design, manufacturing, materials, and delivery. With the addition of pulp fibre bottle technology, Alternicq is broadening its packaging capabilities beyond rigid plastic packaging to include renewable and recyclable packaging formats. The company said the development will help it offer a wider range of packaging solutions to FMCG brands, consumer goods companies, and global customers seeking sustainable packaging alternatives.
The company's transformation strategy is focused on strengthening customer engagement across categories, channels, and markets while expanding access to global packaging technologies through strategic partnerships. Alongside enhancing its go-to-market capabilities, Alternicq is also pursuing collaborations in areas such as packaging materials, recycling technologies, packaging formats, and supply chain innovation.
Pulpex's pulp fibre bottles are manufactured using sustainably sourced wood pulp and are designed to be recycled through standard household paper and cardboard recycling streams. The bottles incorporate a sprayed-on inner barrier coating that does not require separation during the recycling process. The packaging technology is also designed to work with existing filling infrastructure and supports direct-to-shape decoration across multiple FMCG applications.
Thimmaiah NP, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Alternicq said, "We are building a one-stop packaging solutions business of global scale, investing in how we go to market, strengthening our capabilities from design to delivery, and partnering with the worlds leading technology innovators to bring the best solutions to our customers. Our ambition is simple: to provide every format, every material and every solution a customer needs, under one roof. By integrating innovative, sustainable materials and advanced packaging technologies into our rigid plastic packaging portfolio, we are expanding our capabilities to meet evolving customer needs across FMCG segments. Our partnership with Pulpex marks a significant step in this journey, bringing sustainable pulp fibre bottle technology to India and expanding the possibilities of what packaging can be."
Under the exclusive agreement, Alternicq and Pulpex will jointly assess market opportunities for fibre bottle packaging in India. The evaluation will include customer demand, priority industry segments, regulatory requirements, product specifications, and manufacturing infrastructure needed for local production. The agreement combines Pulpex's packaging technology with Alternicq's manufacturing network, customer relationships, and production capabilities to develop sustainable packaging solutions for the Indian market.
Sandy Westwater, Chief Executive Officer, Pulpex said, "Alternicq is exactly the manufacturing partner this technology needs. The significance of this announcement goes well beyond market entry. It brings together a UK technology platform that has moved from innovation to industrial reality and Indias leading packaging manufacturer, with the capability, the customers and the ambition to deliver renewable packaging at scale making a material impact on our environment by reducing CO emissions and, critically, removing plastic waste on land and in our oceans. Granting exclusivity for India, the GCC and the potential to expand the agreement to Australia, reflects our confidence in Alternicqs capability and in the opportunity these markets represent. Together we are laying the foundation for fibre bottle production at scale in some of the most attractive packaging markets in the world."
Scott Winston, Managing Director and Chief Science and Sustainability Officer, Pulpex added, "India is one of the most important consumer markets in the world and a natural destination for the next phase of Pulpexs growth. This partnership demonstrates the strength of our model. We have developed and industrialised a breakthrough packaging technology in the United Kingdom and are now deploying that capability through Indias leading packaging manufacturer, with exclusive rights across India, the GCC and potentially the Australian market as well."
The partnership reflects the growing focus on sustainable packaging, recyclable packaging materials, fibre-based packaging, and circular economy solutions as FMCG brands increasingly look for alternatives to conventional packaging formats.
Furniture retailer Royaloak Furniture has reported encouraging early sales from its newly introduced Value Store format, a compact retail model aimed at expanding its presence in Tier ll and Tier lll cities across India. Within the first month of operations, the company's Kadur store generated sales of Rs 27 lakh, while the Sira outlet recorded Rs 25 lakh.
The performance highlights growing demand for organised furniture retail in smaller cities, where consumers are increasingly seeking access to branded furniture, home décor, mattresses, and home furnishing products. The Value Store format has been developed to bring Royaloak’s product portfolio closer to customers in emerging markets without the footprint of a large-format showroom. Each outlet spans between 4,000 and 5,550 sq ft and offers a curated range of products tailored to local preferences while providing access to the retailer’s broader catalogue.
Industry trends continue to underline the importance of physical retail in the furniture sector. While online furniture shopping has gained traction, many consumers still prefer to visit stores to evaluate product quality, fabric, comfort, and finishes before making a purchase decision. This preference continues to support the growth of offline furniture retail and organised furniture chains across India.
Over the last ten months, Royaloak has opened seven Value Stores across Chintamani, Kadur, and Sira in Karnataka, Sambalpur in Odisha, Thodupuzha in Kerala, Palani in Tamil Nadu, and Shadnagar in Telangana. The rollout reflects the company's strategy to strengthen its reach in high-potential non-metro markets.
Vijai Subramaniam, Chairman and Co-Founder, Royaloak Furniture said, "Royaloak has always been built on being close to the customer, not only in cities such as Bangalore and Chennai, but across the smaller towns of South India that organised retail has often overlooked. What we are seeing in emerging markets is not a one-off trend, but a sustained shift. Over the last ten months alone, we have added seven new Value Stores across five states, and the response from each of these markets tells us that consumers in smaller cities are actively seeking the same quality, design, and choice that has traditionally been available only in metros. Karnataka is a clear example of this, where our depth of presence shows just how far this demand runs. We intend to keep pace with this expansion in the months ahead."
According to industry estimates, India's furniture market is expected to grow from approximately $27.27 billion this year to between $40 billion and $45 billion by 2031. Organised furniture retail currently accounts for around 18.2 percent of the market, leaving significant opportunities for branded retailers to expand their market share.
With more than 200 stores across India, including 60 in Karnataka and 30 in Bengaluru, Royaloak continues to assess expansion opportunities based on consumer demand, residential development, accessibility, and local market conditions. The company plans to use a mix of large-format stores and compact Value Stores to support its next phase of growth.
Preventive healthcare and nutrition brand Good Monk is on track to close the current financial year with Rs 150 crore in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), marking a 10-fold increase in business scale over the last 15 months. The company said repeat purchase revenue has grown faster than overall revenue during the period, indicating increasing consumer adoption and retention. The growth reflects more households incorporating the brand’s nutrition products into their daily routines.
Good Monk, known for its tasteless add-to-food nutrition products, has also reported significant progress in its profitability journey. The company has improved from a negative 50 percent EBITDA position and is now on track to achieve EBITDA positivity within the current fiscal year. According to the company, the improvement has been driven by revenue growth outpacing operating costs.
A major share of the brand’s growth is coming from beyond India's major metropolitan markets. More than 65 percent of Good Monk’s revenue now originates from non-metro cities, reflecting growing demand for preventive healthcare, nutrition supplements, and daily wellness products across smaller towns and cities. The company’s flagship nutrition products have also ranked among the top multivitamins on Amazon India, strengthening its position in the country’s growing health and wellness market.
Amarpreet Singh Anand, Co-Founder and CEO, Good Monk said, “We didn’t set out to build a typical nutraceutical brand. We set out to solve a problem — the fact that most Indian families have no practical way to close the nutrition gaps in their daily diet. Growing 10x in 15 months, with repeat revenue scaling even faster, didn’t happen because of marketing. It happened because the product has earned trust inside the household. Our customers are reordering because consumption is taking place without resistance. That’s the only growth engine that compounds. Everything else is noise.”
Looking ahead, Good Monk plans to expand its product portfolio to address clinically validated nutrition requirements across different age groups. The company said future launches will focus on solving common nutritional deficiencies through products backed by end-product clinical trials while maintaining affordability for Indian consumers. The expansion strategy comes at a time when the Indian nutraceutical market, preventive healthcare sector, and wellness nutrition category continue to witness rising consumer interest driven by increasing health awareness and demand for daily nutrition solutions.
Farm-to-consumer food brand KisaanSay is aiming to work with 2 lakh farmers by FY27 as it expands its sourcing footprint across 15 states in India. The agri-food startup is strengthening its farmer network and product sourcing capabilities to meet growing demand for traceable, single-origin food products while supporting farmer incomes.
Founded by Nitin Puri, Vaishali Mehta, and Manoj Karki, KisaanSay currently partners with farmer enterprises and farmer producer companies (FPCs) to source food products directly from agricultural communities. The company operates through a farm-to-consumer model that focuses on reducing supply chain gaps and improving market access for farmers.
The expansion plan includes increasing sourcing operations across 15 states and significantly growing its farmer network to 2 lakh by FY27. The move aligns with the company's broader strategy of scaling agricultural procurement, strengthening rural livelihoods, and expanding access to natural and single-origin food products across India.
KisaanSay currently offers more than 100 SKUs across multiple food categories and has built partnerships with farmer enterprises covering tens of thousands of farmers across the country. The company distributes its products through its direct-to-consumer platform, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce channels, and select offline retail stores.
Earlier this year, the Gurugram-based startup raised Rs 34 crore in a Series A funding round led by NABVENTURES. The capital is being deployed towards expanding distribution, strengthening technology infrastructure, growing its sourcing ecosystem, and increasing market reach.
As India's agri-food sector continues to evolve, companies such as KisaanSay are increasingly focusing on direct sourcing, food traceability, farmer partnerships, and sustainable supply chains to meet changing consumer preferences while creating additional income opportunities for farming communities.
Pluckk, an Indian digital-first clean-label food and FMCG brand, has entered the United Kingdom as part of its international expansion strategy, with plans to scale its retail presence to 500 stores within a year.
Within the first month of its UK launch, the brand has established a presence in 17 stores and secured a 15% share of the protein bar category across these outlets, according to the company. It aims to expand to 100 stores across multiple retail chains within three months, with local grocery chains and online marketplaces expected to become additional distribution channels.
The company also plans to expand its UK portfolio from a limited initial range to more than 50 stock-keeping units (SKUs) across clean-label food and beverage categories. These will include cold-pressed fruit juices, functional drinks, healthy crisps, snacks, salads, and tomato ketchup.
Pluckk's UK entry comes amid growing consumer interest in healthier food choices. The company sees opportunities in markets where consumers are increasingly seeking products that combine convenience, nutrition, and ingredient transparency.
According to the company, the UK Food Standards Agency's latest survey found that approximately 75% of consumers had made dietary changes for health reasons. Pluckk believes this shift, alongside the emergence of clean-label brands in India, creates opportunities for Indian FMCG businesses offering products that meet international quality standards.
“Pluckk was built with a simple vision – to make clean, nutritious food accessible to everyone. We believe consumers shouldn’t have to compromise between what is good for them and what is convenient, affordable and enjoyable. As we enter the UK, we are taking this vision to a new market where we see a growing appetite for better, cleaner food choices. This expansion is not just about taking Pluckk to the UK; it is about taking our larger mission global and making clean food a more accessible part of everyday life,” said Pratik Gupta, Co-founder and CEO, Pluckk.
Pluckk has established a presence across several regions in England and Wales, including Lancashire, Merseyside, Yorkshire, Lincolnshire, the Midlands, East Sussex, Carmarthenshire, and Pembrokeshire.
The company is pursuing a geographically diversified retail expansion strategy, extending its reach across urban and suburban markets rather than concentrating exclusively on major cities. It plans to strengthen its presence through additional retail partnerships and distribution channels.
The planned expansion to 100 stores within three months and 500 stores within a year will be key milestones in building the brand's distribution network and increasing product accessibility in the UK market.
Beyond the UK, Pluckk is evaluating opportunities in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, particularly the UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as the United States.
The company expects international markets to contribute 25% to 30% of its overall revenue, reflecting its ambition to build a global business around clean-label food and beverage products.
The UK launch marks the first step in Pluckk's international growth strategy. Its ability to expand retail distribution, broaden its product portfolio, and establish repeat consumer demand will be important factors in determining the pace and scale of its overseas business.
Diamond Jewellery Limited, the certified natural diamond jewellery brand operating under the Reva Diamonds by PNGS label, has reported a strong financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Backed by the 194-year legacy of the P. N. Gadgil & Sons Group, the company recorded a 46.25 percent year-on-year increase in revenue from operations, excluding gold sales, reaching Rs 120.54 crore in Q2 FY27 compared to Rs 82.42 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
The growth comes despite the absence of key festive days during the July-September quarter. Traditionally, the Dussehra-Diwali period is among the strongest sales seasons for jewellery retailers. While nine festive days were part of Q2 FY26, no such festive days fell within the same quarter this year, making the company’s performance particularly noteworthy.
For the first half of FY27, revenue from operations excluding gold sales rose 75.75 percent to Rs 236.53 crore, compared to Rs 134.58 crore in H1 FY26. Including gold sales, revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at Rs 120.54 crore, up 17.46 percent year-on-year, while H1 FY27 revenue increased 52.19 percent to Rs 238.51 crore.
During the quarter, Reva expanded its retail footprint with the opening of two company-owned, company-operated stores at Amanora Mall in Pune and Agora Commercial Complex in Nashik. With these additions, the company’s network now comprises 38 points of sale, including four exclusive stores and 34 shop-in-shop counters.
The company also entered the e-commerce space with the launch of revadiamonds.com, enabling customers to browse and purchase certified natural diamond jewellery online. The move is aimed at extending the brand’s reach beyond its physical retail network and improving accessibility for customers across markets.
Amit Modak, CEO, Reva Diamonds by PNGS said, “Jewellery retail has traditionally been closely linked to the festive calendar, and this quarter gave us none of it. Last year, nine festive days fell within Q2; this year, there were none. Against that backdrop, our 46% revenue growth is particularly encouraging. It indicates that consumers are increasingly choosing diamonds for personal milestones, celebrations and self-expression, rather than limiting purchases to festive occasions. Our new stores in Pune and Nashik are performing as planned, while our COCO expansion remains on track. With the upcoming wedding season, Dussehra and Diwali, we enter the second half of the year well positioned to serve customers looking for larger and more significant jewellery purchases.”
Aditya Modak, Director, Reva Diamonds by PNGS, added, “Reva was built around a simple proposition — certified natural diamond jewellery backed by a family name that customers have trusted for generations. During the quarter, we took this proposition to more customers through both our expanding retail network and our digital platform. The addition of Amanora and Nashik strengthens our presence in key customer markets, while revadiamonds.com gives customers the convenience of discovering and purchasing Reva jewellery online. As we expand across stores and digital channels, our focus remains on making natural diamond jewellery more accessible, relevant and effortless for today's consumer.”
Looking ahead, the company expects the upcoming wedding season along with the Dussehra-Diwali festive period to support stronger consumer demand and higher average order values. Reva also remains on track to open around 15 new company-owned stores within 24 months of its IPO, with expansion focused on Tier I cities and select Tier II and metro markets.
Gaurs Group has sold out the entire available inventory of its newly launched premium residential project, Gaur Alaris, during a two-day allotment event held for homebuyers. Located in Sector 22D on the Yamuna Expressway near the upcoming Noida International Airport, the project offered 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments and recorded strong demand shortly after bookings opened.
Launched in August 2026, Gaur Alaris is expected to generate sales realisation of approximately Rs 1,900 crore. The development follows the company's earlier luxury housing project, Gaur NYC Residences, which was sold out within 60 hours before its official launch.
The latest sell-out highlights growing demand for residential real estate along the Yamuna Expressway corridor, which has witnessed increased buyer interest due to infrastructure development, improved connectivity, and the upcoming Noida International Airport. The region has emerged as a key destination for both end-users and property investors.
Manoj Gaur, CMD, Gaurs Group said, “The response to Gaur Alaris is a strong endorsement of the evolving potential of the Yamuna Expressway as a residential destination. The complete sell-out reflects the confidence buyers have in the corridor as well as in the quality, planning and execution that Gaurs Group brings to its developments. It is also a testament to the trust and belief our customers have in us, the legacy that has been built over 3 decades by timely delivery of all our projects.”
The project has been designed around a peacock-inspired concept and features Art Deco architecture by Hafeez Contractor. Landscape planning has been undertaken by Site Concepts International, while interior design has been developed by Studio Designscape. Gaur Alaris includes a clubhouse spread across more than 1 lakh sq ft, nearly eight acres of landscaped open spaces, and over 65 amenities across the residential development.
Sarthak Gaur, Director, Gaursons India Pvt Ltd said, “The Allotment Day of Gaur Alaris was a big success and is an endorsement of the trust of our buyers and the credibility of Gaurs Group. The complete sell-out of Gaur Alaris reflects the strong momentum that the Yamuna Expressway is currently witnessing. The Noida International Airport has added a significant new dimension to the region, while the overall infrastructure ecosystem continues to improve. Also, to our advantage, we already had a strong footprint in this region as we have already delivered a 250-acre integrated township – Gaur Yamuna City on Yamuna Expressway which is today home to almost 15000 residents.”
The project adds to Gaurs Group's premium and luxury housing portfolio, which includes developments such as The Islands by Gaurs, Legacy by Gaurs, Trecento Residences by Gaurs, Gaur NYC Residences, and Gaur Chrysalis. The company said it plans to launch two additional residential projects on the Yamuna Expressway in the near future as demand in the region continues to grow.
Nykaa reported strong growth across its beauty and fashion businesses for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, supported by store expansion, customer acquisition, omnichannel growth, and brand additions. The beauty and lifestyle retailer said its Beauty vertical is expected to record net sales value (NSV) growth and net revenue growth in the late twenties on a year-on-year basis during the second quarter.
The performance was driven by continued omnichannel expansion, growth in new customers, higher repeat purchases, and improved offline retail performance. Nykaa's physical retail business also recorded like-for-like (LFL) store sales growth in the early twenties, marking the highest LFL growth rate for its store network in the last six quarters.
As part of its retail expansion strategy, Nykaa added 14 net new stores during the quarter, taking its total offline store count to 338 as of September 30, 2026. The expansion further strengthens the company's omnichannel retail presence across India's beauty and personal care market.
The company's owned brand portfolio, House of Nykaa, continued to outperform the broader Beauty business during the quarter. Growth was supported by established brands within the portfolio as well as emerging beauty labels across skincare, cosmetics, and personal care categories. Nykaa's Fashion business also maintained strong momentum as it continued to scale operations. The company expects Fashion NSV growth in the late forties and net revenue growth in the early forties year-on-year, increasing the segment's contribution to overall revenue.
Product assortment expansion remained a key focus area during the quarter. Across its beauty and fashion platforms, Nykaa onboarded more than 250 brands in Q2 FY27, broadening consumer choice across categories. The company also reported early consumer interest following its exclusive partnership with Nike, which was announced during the period.
Nykaa noted that the timing of India's festive season affected quarterly demand patterns. A significant share of festive shopping activity shifted into the third quarter of FY27 rather than the September quarter. As a result, the company expects the December quarter to witness the bulk of festive demand and sales volumes. Despite the timing shift, Nykaa said its long-term growth drivers across beauty retail, fashion e-commerce, omnichannel retail, and owned brands remain unchanged.
The update highlights continued momentum in India's beauty retail and fashion retail sectors, with store expansion, premium brand partnerships, and omnichannel growth supporting Nykaa's business performance.
Ahead of the festive season, Amazon India has announced the expansion of its Ashray network with 50 new centres across the country, taking the total number of operational centres to 200. The company said it remains on track to reach 250 Ashray centres by the end of 2026 as it continues to strengthen support infrastructure for delivery drivers.
Amazon India also expanded its mobile Ashray van initiative to Bengaluru, making it the fourth city after Delhi NCR, Mumbai, and Hyderabad to receive the service. Two mobile Ashray vans were flagged off in Bengaluru in the presence of Sandy Gordon, Vice President, Employee Experience and Relations, Amazon, and Brendan Branon, Vice President of North America (NA) Employee Relations (ER).
The move comes ahead of the festive shopping season, a period that typically sees a significant rise in e-commerce orders and last-mile deliveries across India.
Salim R. Memon, Director – Operations, Amazon India said, "With the festive season driving a sharp increase in deliveries, it's more important than ever that drivers across the industry have access to rest on their routes. Ashray was built on a simple idea — that every delivery driver, whether they deliver for Amazon or not, deserves a clean, cool place to rest during their workday. Expanding to 200 centres and bringing mobile vans to more cities means we can reach more drivers in more cities, right when they need it most. This expansion is part of Amazon India's broader investment of over INR 2,800 crore (~USD 300 million) in 2026 to strengthen associate safety, health, and financial well-being across its operations network."
Launched in 2024, the Ashray initiative has grown into one of India's largest delivery driver welfare programmes. The centres are open to all delivery drivers, including those not associated with Amazon. The facilities provide air-conditioned seating, drinking water, mobile charging points, clean washrooms, first-aid support, and designated rest areas. Each centre can accommodate 10 to 15 people at a time and allows free access for up to 30 minutes per visit. The centres operate throughout the year from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. and are located at high-footfall areas such as petrol pumps and commercial hubs. Their locations are also listed on Google Maps to improve accessibility.
To complement the fixed centres, Amazon's mobile Ashray vans provide similar amenities directly on high-density delivery routes. The fully air-conditioned vans offer seating, drinking water, free Wi-Fi connectivity, and mobile charging facilities, allowing delivery personnel to take short breaks during work hours.
Ashray Expansion Timeline
- 2024: Pilot launched with Ashray centres across Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, and Mumbai.
- 2025: Expanded to 100 centres across 16 cities.
- May 2026: Added 50 new centres, taking the total to 150; mobile Ashray vans launched in Delhi NCR.
- September 2026: Announced 50 additional centres, increasing the total to 200; mobile Ashray vans now operational in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.
- End of 2026 Target: 250 Ashray centres across India.
The latest expansion is part of Amazon India's broader investment in delivery associate welfare, logistics infrastructure, and last-mile operations as e-commerce demand continues to grow across the country.
Canon India plans to expand its consumer printing retail network to more than 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by the end of 2027, doubling its current reach as it looks to deepen its presence in Tier II, Tier III and Tier IV markets. The expansion follows sustained double-digit year-on-year growth in Canon India’s Consumer Printing business. The company is looking to improve access to printing products and services while growing its presence across consumer, SME, education, enterprise and institutional segments in India.
Demand for printing solutions is evolving across homes, schools, small businesses and enterprises, particularly in smaller cities where entrepreneurship, digital adoption and education-related requirements are increasing. Canon aims to use its wider retail network to improve product availability, strengthen local distribution and provide customers with access to product consultation and after-sales support.
The company is also investing in product development, digital commerce and partner capabilities as part of its wider India growth strategy. Building on the Canon Passport Program, which supports more than 5,000 active reseller partners through a digital rewards and engagement platform, Canon India is introducing BizBee for its B2B partner network.
BizBee will cater to System Integrators, Value-Added Resellers and other partners by providing access to incentives, product and solution training, technical certifications, business resources and digital tools. The initiative is intended to strengthen Canon’s B2B channel ecosystem across enterprise, education and institutional markets.
Toshiaki Nomura, President and CEO, Canon India said, “India is central to Canon’s long-term growth ambitions, underpinned by the resilience of its economy and the emergence of new centres of enterprise and consumption. As education, digitisation and infrastructure reshape demand across Tier lll and Tier IV markets, we see a significant opportunity to unlock the next phase of growth for our printing business. Our ambition to build a network of over 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by 2027 reflects our commitment to invest ahead of the curve and bring Canon closer to customers through trusted touchpoints that combine first-hand product experience with expert guidance. By combining scale with customer-led innovation and strong channel partnerships, we are positioning Canon to lead and shape the future of printing in India.”
To support the expansion, Canon India is strengthening its omnichannel distribution network across traditional resellers, large-format retail chains, e-commerce, quick commerce and enterprise-focused partners. The company currently operates more than 400 active PIXMA Zones across India and plans to add over 500 PIXMA Zone Lite stores this year. Its Canon eSHOP platform also allows authorised resellers to showcase and sell Canon products digitally.
The wider channel strategy is aimed at giving customers flexibility to research and purchase products across online and offline retail formats while enabling Canon to extend its presence beyond major metropolitan markets. Canon is also increasing investment in retailer engagement and frontline sales capabilities. Its Retail Display Incentive Program currently covers over 1,000 partners and focuses on strengthening product visibility at physical retail outlets.
At the same time, the company plans to scale its RetailChamp Initiative from 400 to more than 1,000 retail sales personnel. The programme focuses on improving product knowledge and customer consultation across the company's retail network. Beyond consumer retail, Canon India intends to expand its System Integrator network to more than 500 partners nationwide. The move is expected to increase its reach across enterprise, education and government segments.
C Sukumaran, Vice President, Canon India said, “Our channel ecosystem will be central to translating Canon’s growth ambition into business impact. As we expand our reach, our focus is on building the capabilities of our partners and frontline teams to understand local needs, create demand and deliver trusted customer experience. Through initiatives such as Canon Passport, RetailChamp and BizBee, we are strengthening partner engagement, knowledge and enablement across the ecosystem. BizBee, in particular, will equip our B2B partners and System Integrators with the training, certifications and business tools needed to unlock opportunities across enterprise, education and government segments. Together, these efforts will help us build a more capable partner network and drive solution-led growth across consumer, SME and institutional markets.”
Canon’s expansion strategy brings together physical retail, digital commerce, reseller engagement and B2B channel development as the company increases its reach across India. The planned addition of retailers, PIXMA Zone Lite stores, System Integrators and trained frontline personnel is expected to support Canon’s consumer printing business across smaller cities while strengthening its ability to serve education, SME, enterprise and institutional customers.
Carlsberg India has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for its confidential pre-filing of documents for a proposed initial public offering (IPO). The company had submitted its draft IPO papers to SEBI through the confidential route in July 2026. This process allows companies to keep their draft offer documents private during the initial review, before deciding when to make the filing public.
The approval marks a key milestone in Carlsberg India’s proposed initial public offering (IPO). Details regarding the issue size, timeline, and other terms are expected to be disclosed in the offer documents, subject to the necessary regulatory and corporate approvals.
The proposed listing comes amid growing interest among multinational companies in India’s equity markets, as businesses look to unlock value from their investments in the country. The potential IPO would add to the activity in India’s primary market, with anticipated offerings from companies such as Jio Platforms drawing investor attention.
Carlsberg India commenced commercial operations in June 2007 with the launch of Carlsberg Green, entering India’s premium beer segment. Since then, the company has expanded its presence in the domestic beer market through a portfolio of brands, including Carlsberg and Tuborg.
The parent company has also reported positive volume growth across key markets. In its earnings guidance for the six months ended June 30, 2026, Danish brewer Carlsberg reported overall volume growth of 2.8%, while organic volume growth stood at 1.7%. Europe recorded volume growth of 0.1%, while the Central and Eastern Europe and India region registered growth of 6.2%.
The performance highlights the contribution of the Central and Eastern Europe and India region to the group's volume growth during the first half of 2026. With SEBI approval secured, Carlsberg India has taken another step toward its proposed public listing, with further details expected to emerge following the release of the relevant offer documents.
Global apparel retailer UNIQLO has reopened its expanded store at Ambience Mall, Gurugram, strengthening its retail presence in North India and offering customers a larger shopping destination featuring the brand’s latest seasonal collections and customer engagement initiatives.
The reopening was marked by a traditional Taiko drum performance, creating a festive atmosphere that attracted a large number of shoppers to the store. Customers visiting the revamped outlet were introduced to the expanded retail space and a wider assortment of products across key categories.
The enlarged store features UNIQLO’s latest Fall/Winter collection, including seasonal essentials such as Fleece, Knitwear, HEATTECH and PUFFTECH. The expansion is aimed at improving the overall shopping experience while providing consumers with greater access to the brand’s apparel and technology-driven clothing solutions.
In addition to the product showcase, UNIQLO introduced a series of customer-focused experiences designed to encourage participation and community engagement. One of the highlights was the UNIQLO Share Wall, an interactive installation where visitors could share personal stories and experiences about what they appreciate most about the brand.
The company also promoted sustainability through its RE: UNIQLO initiative. A dedicated donation box was installed at the store, encouraging customers to contribute pre-loved clothing that can be redirected to individuals and communities in need. The initiative forms part of UNIQLO’s broader efforts to support responsible consumption and extend the lifecycle of garments.
To celebrate the reopening, UNIQLO has announced a range of special promotional offers, available from October 2 to October 8. The limited-period deals are intended to drive footfall to the newly expanded outlet while giving customers an opportunity to explore the retailer’s latest collections and in-store experiences.
The Ambience Mall store expansion reflects UNIQLO’s continued focus on strengthening its retail footprint in India. By combining a larger retail format, seasonal product innovations, and community-driven initiatives, the brand aims to deepen its engagement with consumers while reinforcing its position in the country’s growing fashion and apparel market.
Reliance-backed online healthcare platform Netmeds reported steady financial performance for FY26, maintaining profitability despite recording only moderate growth in revenue.
Revenue from operations increased 2.3 percent to Rs 44.7 crore in FY26, compared to Rs 43.7 crore in FY25. The digital healthcare and online pharmacy platform posted a profit of Rs 5.5 crore during the fiscal year, continuing its profitable run despite a relatively stable topline.
Netmeds operates across multiple healthcare segments, including online pharmacy, diagnostics, teleconsultation services, and healthcare product sales. In addition to product transactions, the company derives income from healthcare-related services and marketing activities.
Services remained the primary contributor to the company’s business during the year. Gross service income stood at Rs 46.3 crore, largely unchanged from Rs 46.2 crore reported in the previous fiscal. Revenue generated from the sale of goods, however, registered stronger growth, rising 24 percent to Rs 6.03 crore from Rs 4.86 crore in FY25.
Netmeds reported operating revenue of Rs 44.7 crore. The company also earned Rs 3.24 crore from non-operating income, taking its total income to Rs 47.94 crore for FY26.
The company significantly increased spending on brand visibility and customer outreach initiatives during the year. Advertising and promotional expenses jumped 76 percent to Rs 2.9 crore, compared to Rs 1.65 crore in FY25. Additional overhead expenses, including legal, professional, and rental costs, amounted to Rs 12.24 crore.
Overall expenditure increased to Rs 42.4 crore from Rs 41.6 crore in the previous fiscal year. Despite the rise in costs, Netmeds remained in the black, although its profit declined by around 5 percent year-on-year.
The company reported a return on capital employed (ROCE) of 4.5 percent and an EBITDA margin of 5.66 percent. Operational efficiency remained largely stable, with Netmeds spending approximately Rs 0.95 to generate every Re 1 of operating revenue, in line with FY25 levels.
Reliance Industries, through Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd. (RRVL), acquired a majority stake in Netmeds for approximately Rs 620 crore in August 2020 as part of its expansion into the digital healthcare and e-pharmacy sector.
Netmeds competes with major players in India’s online healthcare market, including Tata 1mg, PharmEasy and Apollo 24/7. During FY26, Tata 1mg reported Rs 2,936 crore in revenue while posting a consolidated loss of Rs 287 crore, whereas API Holdings, the parent company of PharmEasy, reported Rs 6,869 crore in revenue.
Cinema exhibitor Cinépolis India has strengthened its presence in Haryana with the launch of a new four-screen multiplex at Amolik’s City Life Mall in Sector 28, Faridabad.
With the latest opening, the company has doubled its footprint in the city to eight screens, less than a year after inaugurating its first Faridabad property at Pacific Mall.
The newly launched multiplex houses 549 seats across four screens and offers recliner seating, Dolby sound technology and the brand’s food and beverage services. The opening comes ahead of the Gandhi Jayanti holiday weekend and the release of Drishyam: The Conclusion on October 2.
The expansion is part of Cinépolis India’s broader growth strategy across the Delhi-NCR cinema market. In recent months, the multiplex chain has added new properties at IREO Grand High Street in Gurugram and Dwarka, taking its regional network to 16 cinemas and 78 screens.
Devang Sampat, Managing Director, Cinépolis India said, "For us, growth is really a catchment question. Sector 28, has settled residential neighbourhoods on every side, and Faridabad is a big city, so there's room here for more than one Cinépolis. The choice of mall matters just as much. Amolik has built City Life as a place where families already come to eat and shop, and a good cinema gives them one more reason to spend the evening there. When a cinema runs well, the businesses around it do well too."
Located in the residential hub of Sector 28, City Life Mall has been developed by Amolik, whose portfolio in Faridabad also includes projects such as Amolik Heights and Amolik Residency.
Canon India has announced plans to expand its consumer printing distribution network to more than 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by the end of 2027, doubling its current reach as the company looks to capitalize on growing demand for printing solutions across India.
The expansion comes amid sustained double-digit growth in Canon’s consumer printing business and is aimed at increasing product accessibility across Tier II, III, and IV markets. The company expects the initiative to support growth across consumer, SME, education, enterprise, and institutional segments.
Through its planned expansion across 700 cities, the company aims to improve product availability, enhance brand visibility, and provide greater access to consultation and after-sales support.
Toshiaki Nomura, President & CEO, Canon India, said, “India is central to Canon’s long-term growth ambitions, underpinned by the resilience of its economy and the emergence of new centres of enterprise and consumption. As education, digitisation and infrastructure reshape demand across Tier 3 and Tier 4 markets, we see a significant opportunity to unlock the next phase of growth for our printing business. Our ambition to build a network of over 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by 2027 reflects our commitment to invest ahead of the curve and bring Canon closer to customers through trusted touchpoints that combine first-hand product experience with expert guidance. By combining scale with customer-led innovation and strong channel partnerships, we are positioning Canon to lead and shape the future of printing in India.”
To support the expansion, Canon is enhancing its omnichannel strategy across traditional retail, large-format stores, e-commerce, quick commerce, and enterprise-focused channels. The company currently operates more than 400 PIXMA Zones nationwide and plans to add over 500 PIXMA Zone Lite stores this year. Its Canon eSHOP platform also enables authorized resellers to showcase and sell products digitally.
Canon is further strengthening its partner ecosystem through initiatives such as the Canon Passport Program, which supports more than 5,000 reseller partners, and the newly launched BizBee platform for system integrators and value-added resellers. BizBee will provide partners with training, certifications, incentives, and business tools to enhance solution-led selling.
The company is also investing in retail engagement programs, including the Retail Display Incentive Program and RetailChamp Initiative, which is being expanded from 400 to over 1,000 retail sales personnel to improve product expertise and customer support.
Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited has commissioned a new 10 MW solar power plant at Arasanoor, further strengthening its renewable energy infrastructure and sustainability initiatives. The latest addition comes alongside the 15 MW solar facility already operational at the same location, taking the company’s total investment in the 25 MW Arasanoor solar project to Rs 109.60 crore.
With the commissioning of the new facility, Milky Mist’s renewable energy portfolio has grown to 41 MW. The company’s renewable assets now include 5 MW at Chithode, 9 MW at Kavilipalayam, 25 MW at Arasanoor, and 2 MW of wind power at Kayathar. According to the company, renewable energy sources now meet its entire power requirement across operations.
The solar installations have been developed on arid and open land that is not suitable for agricultural use, allowing the company to utilize such areas for renewable energy generation while supporting its sustainability goals.
The newly operational 25 MW solar facility is expected to generate around 20 million units of renewable electricity annually and supply power to Milky Mist’s integrated manufacturing facility in Perundurai as well as its milk chilling centers. The additional capacity is also projected to reduce dependence on conventional energy sources and help avoid nearly 16,000 tonnes of carbon emissions every year.
Beyond solar and wind energy, the company has invested in steam turbine technology and a methane gas purification plant that generates approximately 15,000 units of electricity daily. Methane produced through effluent treatment processes is purified and converted into compressed natural gas (CNG), while biomass is also used in boiler operations to further reduce reliance on conventional energy sources.
T Sathish Kumar, Chairman and Managing Director, Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited said, “At Milky Mist, our approach to growth has always been guided by a long-term vision of building a business that is responsible in its use of resources and conscious of its impact on the environment. We believe that sustainability must be embedded in the way an enterprise is built, operated and scaled, rather than viewed as a standalone initiative. Our investments in renewable energy, resource-efficient technologies and alternative sources of power are a reflection of this philosophy. The commissioning of our new 10 MW solar power plant is another significant step in this journey, taking renewable sources to over 90% of our total power requirements. As we continue to expand our operations, our endeavour is to strengthen energy self-sufficiency, advance more sustainable manufacturing practices and create enduring value for our business, our stakeholders and the environment.”
The latest investment aligns with Milky Mist’s broader strategy of building a technology-driven and resource-efficient manufacturing ecosystem, while continuing to explore opportunities to enhance energy efficiency and expand the use of renewable power across its operations.
Amazon India has expanded its ultra-fast delivery service, Amazon Now, to more than 120 cities across the country, doubling the service’s reach within two weeks. The expansion brings the quick-commerce offering to several new markets, including Amritsar, Abohar, Jalandhar, Ambala, Mangalore, Manipal, Visakhapatnam, Kochi, Changanassery, Bhubaneswar, and Karwar.
Amazon Now enables customers to receive deliveries within minutes and offers access to a broad assortment of daily essentials. The service covers categories such as groceries, including fresh fruits and vegetables, frozen foods, personal care products, beauty items, fashion, small appliances, home essentials, and kitchen products.
To support the growing network, Amazon is leveraging nearly 800 micro-fulfilment and urban fulfilment centres across India. The infrastructure is designed to facilitate rapid deliveries while expanding product availability in both metropolitan and emerging markets.
Harsh Goyal, Vice President – Everyday Essentials, Amazon India said, "We are delighted to take ultra-fast deliveries with Amazon Now to India’s hinterland – from Amritsar & Abohar in the north to Kochi & Changanassery in the south – ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival. Amazon Now continues to be the fastest-growing ecommerce business unit in Amazon India's history with orders doubling every quarter. This accelerated rollout underscores our commitment to making fast & reliable delivery accessible to customers across the country. We look forward to continue scaling up and offering the widest selection of products at the fastest delivery speeds this festive season.”
The announcement follows Amazon’s recent disclosure that Amazon Now achieved an annualized gross sales run rate of $1 billion in India over the past three-month period. The company plans to further scale the service to more than 300 cities as it works toward building one of the country’s largest delivery-in-minutes networks.
Ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival, which begins on October 8, customers using Amazon Now will have access to deals across multiple product categories. Amazon will also offer a 10 percent instant discount on SBI Credit Cards, Debit Cards, and EMI transactions, while Prime members will be eligible for additional savings on select purchases.
Acerpure India, a part of the Acer Group, has introduced its new Nitro QLED TV range in India. The smart TV lineup is now available on Flipkart and includes 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch screen variants, targeting consumers seeking large-screen home entertainment and gaming experiences.
The new Nitro QLED TVs combine QLED display technology with a 120Hz HSR refresh rate, aimed at delivering smoother visuals for gaming, sports broadcasts, and high-motion content. The televisions also support Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, offering enhanced picture quality and audio performance. The range runs on Google TV 5.0 Ref+, providing access to streaming platforms, smart TV features, and connected entertainment services.
In terms of audio, the 75-inch and 85-inch models come equipped with 40W box speakers, while the 100-inch variant features a 65W box speaker system. The televisions also include a built-in karaoke feature, expanding their entertainment offering for family and group viewing.
Vasudeva G, Director, Acerpure India said, “The way consumers experience entertainment at home is evolving rapidly, and we see a growing desire for experiences that are not just bigger, but genuinely more immersive and engaging. With Nitro, we are bringing the scale of the big screen into the living room and creating a proposition that is as much about the experience as it is about the technology behind it. The 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch formats reflect our ambition to make larger-than-life entertainment more accessible to Indian consumers. Our association with Akshay Kumar as the brand ambassador for Acerpure further strengthens this vision of connecting technology with contemporary lifestyles and entertainment. Through our partnership with Flipkart, we are excited to take this proposition to consumers across the country.”
The launch comes as demand for premium smart TVs, large-screen displays, connected home entertainment devices, and gaming-focused televisions continues to grow in India. With larger display options and advanced audio-visual features, Acerpure is expanding its presence in the consumer electronics and smart TV market. The Acerpure Nitro QLED TV range is available on Flipkart, with prices starting at Rs 59,999.
ICA-GemLab, an international organisation specialising in diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery testing, is set to open its first laboratory in India this October. The new facility will be located in Surat, Gujarat, a major global hub for diamond processing, jewellery manufacturing, and gemstone trade. The laboratory will offer testing, certification, and reporting services for diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery, providing manufacturers, traders, retailers, jewellery brands, and consumers with access to gemological analysis within India.
The Surat facility marks ICA-GemLab’s first laboratory in the Indian subcontinent and forms part of the organisation’s expansion strategy to strengthen its presence in key global gems and jewellery sourcing markets. The laboratory will operate in coordination with ICA-GemLab’s headquarters in Bangkok and its existing offices in Dubai and Hong Kong.
As one of the world's leading centres for diamond cutting, polishing, and jewellery production, Surat plays a critical role in the global gems and jewellery supply chain. The new laboratory aims to provide testing and reporting services closer to the manufacturing and trading stages before products enter retail channels. ICA-GemLab is affiliated with the International Colored Gemstone Association (ICA), a global trade body representing the coloured gemstone industry. The Surat laboratory will follow the reporting standards, analytical procedures, and professional practices adopted across the ICA-GemLab network.
Kalpesh Desai, who will lead ICA-GemLab India as Director said, “India has a significant share of the world’s diamond processing, with Surat being one of its key centres. Our aim is to provide direct access to our internationally established analytical methods and reporting standards to manufacturers, traders, retailers, designers and consumers. We are working with a long-term plan. We aim to provide reliable gemological information, documented methodologies and analysis that can help traders and consumers make decisions based on appropriate information.”
Amira Hatta, Managing Director, ICA-GemLab Global said, “India is one of the most important markets in the global gems and jewellery industry. Opening a laboratory in Surat will bring our analytical capabilities directly to this market, so that customers will have access to our services closer to where they operate.”
The laboratory will issue three categories of reports: Diamond Reports, Coloured Gemstone Reports, and Jewellery Reports. These services will cater to jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, gemstone traders, retailers, jewellery designers, industry professionals, and end consumers.
Headquartered in Bangkok, ICA-GemLab currently operates offices in Dubai and Hong Kong. The organisation also works with Sri Lanka’s National Gem and Jewellery Authority to provide gem testing services in the country. The launch of the Surat laboratory represents the latest step in its international expansion within the gems, diamonds, and jewellery certification sector.
ITC Ltd has acquired the remaining 52.5 percent stake in Sproutlife Foods Private Ltd for approximately Rs 645 crore, taking full ownership of the health foods company and making it a wholly owned subsidiary. According to a regulatory filing, the FMCG major purchased 13,445 equity shares of Sproutlife Foods through a secondary cash transaction. Following the acquisition, ITC's shareholding in the company has increased from around 47.5 percent to 100 percent.
The transaction was completed on September 28, and Sproutlife Foods became a wholly owned subsidiary of ITC with effect from the same date. The company stated that no regulatory approvals were required for the acquisition. The move is aligned with ITC's strategy to strengthen its presence in the packaged foods, health foods, nutrition products, and FMCG segments while expanding its future-ready food portfolio.
Sproutlife Foods owns and markets products under the Yoga Bar brand, which operates in the healthy snacks, breakfast cereals, protein products, and nutrition-focused food categories. Founded in February 2015, the company has reported steady growth over the past three financial years.
The company recorded a turnover of Rs 452 crore in FY2025-26, up from Rs 200 crore in FY2024-25 and Rs 108 crore in FY2023-24, reflecting strong growth in India's health and wellness food market. The acquisition further strengthens ITC's position in the fast-growing health foods and packaged nutrition category, where consumer demand for better-for-you food products continues to rise.
Pepperfry has entered into a strategic partnership with Imaginest, a home interiors and modular solutions company promoted by the founders of Capstone Life, to strengthen its presence in the modular furniture and home interiors segment. The collaboration will combine Imaginest's design, manufacturing, and project execution capabilities with Pepperfry's omnichannel retail network, consumer reach, and home category expertise. The companies aim to offer customers an integrated experience covering design, customization, manufacturing, delivery, installation, and after-sales support.
The partnership is intended to simplify the home interiors journey by addressing common challenges such as dealing with multiple vendors, pricing transparency, and project execution timelines. Through the association, customers will be able to access modular home solutions through selected Pepperfry store locations.
